source.availability: UN describes regularly updated CSV; direct bulk retrieval and record-level integrity validation still outstanding

scope.unit: One adopted UN General Assembly resolution with a recorded final vote
scope.include: Same resolution cohort and participating eligible UN members for every sphere within a given year
exclude: Consensus decisions without recorded country positions
scope.europeanUnion: EU has no independent UN General Assembly member-state vote. EU institutional stance must not be fabricated. Show EU member-state cohesion as a separate proxy, using frozen EU-27 membership, never equate with an EU vote.

method.yearFilter: calendar year of adoption, not General Assembly session number
method.similarity: Among resolutions where focal country and partner both voted Y/N/A, same vote / shared valid resolutions
method.missing: Exclude absences from similarity denominator, publish coverage and abstention frequency
method.partnerSet: Same frozen UN member partner list for all four voting states; exclude actor itself for each actor, disclose varying denominators
method.euProxy: Mean pairwise EU-27 member-state agreement on same resolution cohort; not directly comparable to country-to-world alignment
method.change: Annual similarity minus 2021 baseline in percentage points; requires matched topic and resolution composition adjustment before diplomatic index scoring
method.directionality: Similarity describes voting agreement, not causal influence or who persuaded whom
sensitivity: Exclude actor's own vote from peer set
method.readiness: No live diplomatic influence needle until common cohort validated and all five actors comparable; EU may require separate method or alternative dimension

evidenceGates.criterion: Versioned original UN voting dataset fetched and checksum recorded
Validate country ISO codes, votes and resolution uniqueness
Common calendar-year resolution cohort and topic controls
EU-27 member-state proxy clearly segregated from sovereign actor measures
Publish country and partner sample sizes, abstentions and missingness
Pass weighting and topic-composition sensitivity analysis
